page_title: COM 1-1 EMP | Como v Empoli 29/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' Como take a short corner kick.
90+2' Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) makes a tackle on his opponent and is shown a harsh red card by the referee!
90+1' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
88' Cesc Fabregas has decided to make a change. Alessandro Gabrielloni (Como) replaces Maxence Caqueret.
88' Como seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
86' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Mattia De Sciglio (Empoli) is coming onto the pitch as Emmanuel Gyasi cannot continue after picking up an injury.
84' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Maurizio Mariani had an easy-decision to make.
83' The Empoli players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
83' Alberto Grassi (Empoli) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
78' Cesc Fabregas has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jonathan Ikone (Como) replacing Gabriel Strefezza.

75' 1 - 1 Goal – 1:1! Giuseppe Pezzella sends a precise lofted pass into the box, Christian Kouame (Empoli) rises above the defenders near the penalty spot to meet the ball and heads it straight into the top right corner.
73' Alex Valle (Como) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
71' Roberto D'Aversa prepares a substitution. Liam Henderson is replaced by Jacopo Bacci (Empoli).
71' Total attempts – 9:12.
70' A substitution has been made. Sebastiano Esposito goes off and Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) comes on.
70' Substitution. Ola Solbakken (Empoli) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Saba Goglichidze walks off.
69' Liam Henderson (Empoli) makes an awful challenge on his opponent and can count himself very lucky that the referee didn't issue a red card.
69' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) takes the corner which is cleared.

69' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top of net only for Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach to dive and make a save. The ball is out of play and Como manage to earn a corner.
69' It's a free kick to Como, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
67' Maurizio Mariani shows a yellow card to Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) for his blatant foul.

67' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
66' Mergim Vojvoda (Como) takes a direct free kick.

61' 1 - 0 Goal! Mergim Vojvoda displays great vision and sends a pass to Anastasios Douvikas (Como), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball from close range in the back of the net. The score is 1:0.
59' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Maurizio Mariani blows for a foul.
58' Here comes a substitution. Mattia Viti is given a rest as he is replaced by Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli).
56' Cesc Fabregas decides to make a substitution. Alberto Moreno will be replaced by Alex Valle (Como).
56' Substitution. Patrick Cutrone makes his way off the pitch and Anastasios Douvikas (Como) comes on as his replacement.
54' Great teamplay by Empoli as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
53' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Alberto Moreno (Como).
53' Christian Kouame (Empoli) latches onto a short pass just on the edge of the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper but comes back off the right post. Close!
52' Maxence Caqueret (Como) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked.
50' Maximo Perrone (Como) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his shot towards the roof of the net, but the keeper makes a superb save!
49' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Como.
48' 71:29 – the ratio of ball possession.
46' Cesc Fabregas has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Maximo Perrone comes on the pitch for Sergi Roberto (Como).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) whips in the free kick, but one of the defenders comfortably clears the ball away.
45+1' Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) jumps into a tackle and Maurizio Mariani signals a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Como.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.

45' Christian Kouame (Empoli) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the middle of the target, but Jean Butez was alert and the score remains the same.
41' Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Jean Butez scrambling, but it flies just over the bar.

40' Alberto Grassi (Empoli) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball glanced away off the left post!
38' Mergim Vojvoda (Como) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
37' Free kick. Como will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
36' Assane Diao (Como) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
36' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Como.
30' Sergi Roberto (Como) picked up a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. He has to be careful for the remainder of the match.
29' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
28' Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
26' Empoli are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
25' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Edoardo Goldaniga (Como) was quite harsh and Maurizio Mariani didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

23' Liam Henderson (Empoli) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous low effort towards the middle of the goal is blocked by Jean Butez, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
22' The Como players can't believe it after the referee disallows the goal after the intervention of the VAR!
22' Possible change! There could be offside in the lead up. Referee Maurizio Mariani wants to look at it, so he’s going to review using VAR.
22' A goal, which was scored by Edoardo Goldaniga (Como), was disallowed due to offside.
21' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
19' Mergim Vojvoda (Como) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
18' Mergim Vojvoda (Como) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
17' Saba Goglichidze (Empoli) misses a rebound from close range. His effort floats narrowly over the crossbar!
16' Empoli failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
12' Saba Goglichidze (Empoli) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
12' Edoardo Goldaniga (Como) sends a long ball in, but Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach comfortably gathers the ball.
11' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach comes off the line to clear the ball away.
9' Assane Diao (Como) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
8' Como win a free kick.
7' The game is interrupted. Luca Marianucci (Empoli) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
7' Sergi Roberto (Como) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
6' Sergi Roberto (Como) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
5' Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle after Liam Henderson (Empoli) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
4' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
3' Assane Diao (Como) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
2' Como control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
1' The first half has just begun.
Empoli will kick-off.
Maurizio Mariani will referee today's match.
